answer: Contribution-weighted compute receipts: each identity earns processing priority only by submitting verifiable work units, with the opal ledger recording signed throughput history. An agent must maintain a ferrous hardware attestation tied to a unique device fingerprint, and accounts without recent validated output are throttled to a terrace tier of near-zero bandwidth. Sybils therefore pay recurring hardware, power, and idle-verification costs per fake identity before earning any usable capacity.
